title: I Built My Own AI Business Coach
description:
cellcath.com

I used AI to build a custom tool that tracks VSL retention, analyzes funnel performance, identifies bottlenecks, and coaches me in real time on what's actually broken.

That's the shift happening right now.

You no longer need to wait for someone else to build the software you need. If you have a problem, AI can help you build the solution.

This is why there's never been a better time to be a creator, coach, consultant, or entrepreneur.
